EMBREIA

Field of Original Coherence

A 60-minute sensory immersion where music, visual art, light, technology and space are composed to let noise soften and new perception become possible.

The need

Continuous input leaves little space to integrate.

Modern life keeps attention under constant demand. Information, sound, screens and internal dialogue accumulate faster than they can be processed.

EMBREIA addresses this condition by creating a deliberately composed hour in which external demands recede and attention can reorganize.

Information / sound / screens
02 / 11
The proposition

A field designed for coherence.

The guest lies down inside a controlled sensory environment. Original music, spatial sound, projected image, light, translucent layers and physical space unfold as one continuous journey.

The aim is to create conditions in which noise can soften, internal systems can move toward greater coherence, and something new can emerge.

This is the central movement around which the artistic, spatial and research layers of EMBREIA are built.

Artistic reference / Marshmallow Laser Feast · Forest Bathing: Lupuna
The guest experience

The body is inside the work.

The guest remains lying down while the experience moves across ceiling, walls, translucent fabrics and the space above the body.

Attention, intensity, silence, anticipation, release and return become compositional materials.

The project

A multidisciplinary work.

EMBREIA is developed at the intersection of artistic practice, realtime technology and the science of perception. No single discipline can build the experience alone.

Artist collaboration model

Bringing together international artists.

EMBREIA is being built as a platform for original collaborations with musicians, visual artists, realtime artists and spatial designers from different countries.

Artists create chapters specifically for the EMBREIA environment. Their work is composed into one shared dramatic arc rather than placed inside the experience as licensed content.

Spatial reference / Numen / For Use · Tape Paris
Technology + research

Realtime system. Measurable response.

TouchDesigner is being explored for generative visuals, multi-surface projection and synchronization with music and programmable light.

The MVP research layer compares baseline, experience and post-experience through self-report, with EEG, HRV and other biosignals considered as exploratory tools. Research hypotheses remain separate from medical claims.

The first proof

Now building the 15-minute EMBREIA MVP.

The first prototype must prove that the experience works as one artistic and technical system, creates a noticeable subjective shift, and is strong enough for an audience, partners and investors to want the full 60-minute form.

Current focus: lock the scope, complete the core team, build the master timeline, assemble the physical environment and test with real participants.
